cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Sandra, I seem to remember you had some family visitors staying with you recently

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Yeah that right. My brother and his family were here a couple of months ago.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: OK, good. Well, I wanted to ask for your advice. I got my cousin and her family visiting next month and as I don’t have kids, I’ve no idea where to take them.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Right. What about accommodation? Are they going to stay with you in your flat?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: No, thankfully. There wouldn’t be room. My cousin wants me to recommend a hotel. Do you know anywhere?

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Yes, I do actually. I always recommend people stay at the King’s Hotel.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Where’s that near?

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: It’s about a five minutes walk from Murray Station, so nice and central. It’s actually on George Street.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Oh yes, I know.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: I think they’re on quite a tight budget, so how much roughly is it to stay there?

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: If you book a family room, it’s about £125 per night.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: My brother paid for two double rooms in the end, and I think that was around £95 for each room.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Oh, that’s not too bad.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: So how old are your cousins’ kids?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Twelve and nine. So I want to organise some trips while they’re here. I was thinking of doing a bus tour of the city centre, as none of them have been here before.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Those bus tours are quite expensive.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: I think it’s better to do a walking tour.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: It gives you a much better feel for the city.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: There’s one that starts from Colton Square.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: It takes a couple of hours and doesn’t cost that much.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Sounds good. I’ll look that up. Thanks.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: If the weather’s nice, one thing you could do is visit the old fort. You could get there by boat. The whole trip takes half a day.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: That’s a really good idea. I’d like to do that myself. And if the weather bad I was thinking they could go to the science museum. But maybe they could do that when I at work.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Yeah don forget it closed on Mondays

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: They here from Saturday for four nights so Tuesday would be best I think

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: And it won’t be so crowded then. Saturdays are terrible. I took my kids to the exhibition on old computers there and it was far too crowded. I wanted to go back but it’s finished now.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: That’s a shame. My cousin’s kids would have enjoyed that.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: There’s another one starting soon on space, which looks really good too.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: OK, well, I’ll mention that to my cousin.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions 7 to 10. Now listen and answer questions 7 to 10.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Have you thought about where to take them to eat?

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Well, I really like all the food stalls at Clacton Market. My cousin’s vegetarian. I know it’s one of the best places for that kind of food.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Definitely, and there’ll be loads of choices for the kids too. You need to get there quite early, though. At the weekend, most of the stores stop serving lunch at 2.30.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Good point. It’s all going to need careful planning. My cousin said she’d love to take the kids to a show at the theatre, but tickets are so expensive.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: I know. But you can get some good deals if you book online with bargained tickets for the following day. On some seats there a 75 discount

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Really. I must try and get some

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Yeah There are lots of things you can do for free as well. No need to spend a fortune.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Like what?

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: They’re coming next month, right? Well, check and see if it’s the same weekend as the Roots Music Festival in Blakewell Gardens.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: R-O-O-T-S?

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Yeah, check it out online. It’s always a family-friendly event and there’s no entry charge.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: That sounds perfect.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: And if you’re in Blakewell Gardens, climb Telegraph Hill. You’ll be able to look right down on the port. Everyone’s always really impressed because it’s so huge.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Oh yeah, I’ve been meaning to do that for ages. I’ve heard the view’s amazing.

cues.speaker: WOMAN
cues.text: Yeah, it’s really worth the effort.

cues.speaker: MAN
cues.text: Well, that’s given me loads of ideas. Thanks so much.
